Richardson is home base

Most cleaning companies you'll find online serve "the Dallas area" from somewhere else. We live and work in Richardson. If you've been looking for a maid service in Richardson that's actually from Richardson, this is it. When you book with us, you're booking a small local business that depends on its reputation with its neighbors — and that shows up in how we clean.

Richardson homes have a lot of personality, and a lot of variety. There are the classic mid-century ranch homes in neighborhoods like Richardson Heights, with original tile bathrooms and hardwood floors that deserve gentle, careful cleaning. There are the established two-story family homes up around Canyon Creek and the north side of town. And there are apartments, townhomes and newer builds closer to CityLine and the UT Dallas area, where move-ins and move-outs happen all year long. We clean all of them, and we adjust to each.

What every Richardson clean covers

  • Kitchens: counters, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors and microwave
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, sinks, mirrors and fixtures
  • Dusting throughout reachable surfaces
  • Vacuuming and mopping all floors
  • Trash emptied and beds made
  • Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge
  • Standard clean add-ons: inside oven, inside refrigerator, interior windows, laundry

Careful with original finishes

A lot of Richardson's homes were built in the 1950s through the 1970s, and many still have the original tile, built-ins or hardwoods that give them character. Those surfaces need the right products and a lighter hand, not harsh chemicals and a fast scrub. We use professional-grade, eco-conscious products, and if you have a product you trust for your floors or counters, we're happy to use yours instead. Just leave it out and mention it in your booking notes.
